rule_name: Procurement officer creation authority
description: procurement_officer can create purchase requests and orders but cannot approve own high-value PO.
validator_message: Procurement officer may create but not self-approve high-value PO.
llm_prompt_instruction: Add separate approval for high-value PO.
healing_guidance: Route approval to procurement_manager.

rule_name: Procurement manager approval authority
description: procurement_manager can approve high-value purchase orders.
validator_message: Procurement approval requires procurement_manager or admin.
llm_prompt_instruction: Use approval role for high-value PO.
healing_guidance: Request procurement manager approval.

rule_name: Purchase order required fields
description: Purchase order requires vendor_id, item_id, quantity, and unit_price.
validator_message: Purchase order is missing vendor, item, quantity, or unit price.
llm_prompt_instruction: Ask for missing purchase order fields.
healing_guidance: Request missing vendor_id, item_id, quantity, or unit_price.

rule_name: Quantity approval threshold
description: Purchase quantity above 100 requires procurement manager approval.
validator_message: Quantity above 100 requires procurement manager approval.
llm_prompt_instruction: Add procurement manager approval for high quantity.
healing_guidance: Insert approval.request_human_approval.

rule_name: PO value finance approval threshold
description: PO value above 500000 LKR requires finance approval.
validator_message: PO value above 500000 LKR requires finance approval.
llm_prompt_instruction: Add finance approval before releasing high-value PO.
healing_guidance: Insert request_finance_budget_approval and human approval.

rule_name: Vendor must be active
description: Vendor must be active before purchase order creation.
validator_message: Inactive vendor cannot be used for PO creation.
llm_prompt_instruction: Validate vendor before creating PO.
healing_guidance: Add validate_vendor and select active vendor.

rule_name: Goods receipt after PO
description: Goods receipt must occur after PO creation.
validator_message: Goods receipt cannot occur before purchase order creation.
llm_prompt_instruction: Order create_purchase_order before record_goods_receipt.
healing_guidance: Reorder candidate.

rule_name: Invoice receipt after PO
description: Invoice receipt must occur after PO creation.
validator_message: Invoice receipt cannot occur before purchase order creation.
llm_prompt_instruction: Order PO creation before invoice receipt.
healing_guidance: Reorder candidate.

rule_name: Three-way match before clearing
description: Clear invoice requires PO, goods receipt, and invoice receipt match.
validator_message: Invoice clearing requires validated three-way match.
llm_prompt_instruction: Generate PO, goods receipt, invoice receipt, and match before clear_invoice.
healing_guidance: Add validate_three_way_match before clearing.

rule_name: Requester cannot approve own high-value PO
description: Requester cannot approve own high-value PO.
validator_message: Requester cannot approve own high-value purchase order.
llm_prompt_instruction: Use a different approver for high-value PO.
healing_guidance: Assign independent procurement_manager approver.

rule_name: Rejected PO cannot clear invoice
description: Rejected PO cannot be used for invoice clearing.
validator_message: Rejected purchase order cannot support invoice clearing.
llm_prompt_instruction: Do not clear invoice linked to rejected PO.
healing_guidance: Escalate purchase exception.

rule_name: Missing PO core fields block
description: Missing vendor_id, item_id, or quantity blocks procurement execution.
validator_message: Missing vendor_id, item_id, or quantity blocks procurement workflow.
llm_prompt_instruction: Ask for missing procurement fields.
healing_guidance: Request vendor_id, item_id, and quantity.

rule_name: Procurement writes require audit
description: All procurement write operations must write an audit log.
validator_message: Procurement write workflow requires audit logging.
llm_prompt_instruction: Append audit.write_audit_log to procurement write workflows.
healing_guidance: Add audit log step.
